tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: All markets with a BitTalk News forecast: price, status phrase, main scenario and a link to the page. Analysis / Elliott-wave markup, NOT investment advice. light — status-markup colour (red — the decline outweighs); not a trade signal. lang — ru or en; default en.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Forecast for a market (BTC, ETH, XAU, …): main and alternative scenarios with targets and an invalidation level, near-term conditions, the big picture by week/day/4 hours, and price levels. Scenarios are Elliott-wave counts, not probabilities; the share of “similar days” is a past frequency. Analysi

tools.name: get_levels
tools.description: Price levels for a market, top to bottom, with distance from price in %: targets, triggers, interest zones, Fibonacci, weekly pivots and invalidation levels. Analysis / Elliott-wave markup, NOT investment advice. lang — ru or en; default en.

tools.name: get_waves
tools.description: Elliott waves: the current count for a timeframe and closed counts (played out / invalidated) with wave points. timeframe — D1 or H1; limit — up to 30 recent counts. Analysis / Elliott-wave markup, NOT investment advice. lang — ru or en; default en.

tools.name: get_order_walls
tools.description: Large limit orders (walls) in the Binance + Bybit order book, spot and futures: bid/ask side, price range, USD size, whether active now. Crypto only. An order-book fact, not a forecast. lang — ru or en; default en.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Market candles: timeframe 15m (last 16 h), 1h (7 days) or 1d (≈ a year); limit — up to 400. lang — ru or en; default en.

tools.name: screener
tools.description: BitTalk News markets screener: market crypto (USDT pairs on Binance), ru (Moscow Exchange) or us (US); sort volume, change or change_abs; covered_only — only coins that have a forecast (forecast field). Analysis / Elliott-wave markup, NOT investment advice. lang — ru or en; default en.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Latest BitTalk News articles (Russian-language source): title, date, rubric, link and first paragraph.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search the latest BitTalk News articles (Russian-language source): all query words in the title or first paragraph.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across forecasts and news (ChatGPT connector / deep-research format): id, title, url.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full document by id from search: forecast:BTC or news:<number>.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: fetch · Public sink: get_forecast · Destructive: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: fetch · Public sink: get_forecast · Destructive: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_assets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
